changeRationale: Proposed revision to reflect potential Annex 11 audit-trail review expectations identified in change-impact assessment RCI-2026-08-29-ANNEX11-AUDIT.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.content: This draft SOP defines the process for periodic review of computerised system audit trails in GxP environments.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.content: Applies to GxP computerised systems where audit trails record changes to GxP-critical data.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
sections.content: System Owner ensures audit trails are enabled. QA reviews audit-trail records per the schedule defined in Section 4.

sections.heading: Procedure
sections.content: Review audit-trail entries for GxP-critical changes at a frequency defined by the quality risk assessment. Document review with reviewer identity and timestamp.

sections.heading: References
sections.content: EU GMP Annex 11; 21 CFR Part 11; applicable validation protocols.

sections.heading: Revision History (proposed)
sections.content: 2.1-draft — proposed revision for Annex 11 alignment review (not effective).

regulatoryTraceability.statement: Procedure section should address traceability of GxP-critical changes to individuals.
regulatoryTraceability.verbatimExcerpt: Relevant changes to GxP critical data should be recorded and traceable to the person who made the change.

regulatoryTraceability.statement: US audit-trail expectations may inform dual-jurisdiction review frequency wording.
regulatoryTraceability.verbatimExcerpt: Use of secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails to independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions.

gaps: Review frequency not yet tied to risk assessment template
uncertainties: Whether proposed review cadence meets both EU and US expectations
